testCase:
T-09: The same button in every row
Goal: Edit the user with the email samir.berg@example.com.
STEP 1: Navigate to /sandbox/t-09/
STEP 2: Click "Edit" in the row whose Email is "samir.berg@example.com"
STEP 3: Verify "Editing samir.berg@example.com" is visible

plan.title: T-09: Edit user by email row

steps.note: Click Edit only in the target user's row.
Confirm the correct user is being edited.

reasoning: This test checks that Edit targets the user with email samir.berg@example.com rather than another row with the same button. The click is scoped to that email's row, then the editing message confirms the correct user was selected.
